name: lv_obj_get_style_prop
prototype: uint32_t(const void *object, uint32_t part, uint32_t property)

ownership.argument: Object is borrowed and must remain live throughout lookup; part and property are scalar selectors.
ownership.return_value: 32-bit ABI carrier for the native style-value union in r0; when property 40 denotes an image source, the pointer is borrowed from the owning style.

provenance.source: Exact .139 AP instruction/call-site inspection and source-compiled Unicorn probes; see EVID-RESOURCE-4139-007.

notes: Returns the effective state/part property value as a 32-bit ABI carrier. Property-40 source pointers are borrowed, not allocated/transferred. Prototype avoids assuming the upstream union typedef. UI-owner thread only, outside IRQ lock; no general veneer approval.
